decision: Restore the missing suffixes of four existing public pingbacks from the 2007 database backup, as requested by the owner on 2026-10-23.
source: data/recovery.json, comment_repairs: exact source text, per-comment SHA-256 and displayed replacement

research_scope.likely_cause: Encoding/import error: each stored string stops immediately before its first non-ASCII character. The historical cause is not directly verified.

preservation: Only the recorded truncated body is extended; authors, dates, IDs, permalinks and neighbouring content are unchanged.
RSS entry IDs, dates, ordering and feed limits are unchanged. Comment 164717 remains outside its article feed ten-item window.
The original HTTP capture, public API export and feed snapshots remain unchanged.
The build rejects unexpected newer text; comparison checks accept only the exact recorded restoration and still flag unrelated loss.
limitations: This browser comparison covers six affected HTML pages, not the entire site.
Restoring text changes page heights; visual findings remain visible and do not waive existing review requirements.
The backup covers only through September 2007.
